patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content sections where one side presents concise information and the other showcases a detailed product UI or visual.
Large, confident sans-serif headings with a lighter weight create a modern and approachable feel, contrasting with clear, readable body text.
A deep, dark mode palette with subtle gradients and a vibrant blue accent color for calls to action and interactive elements.
The hero background image features a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls, adding depth to the scene.
Product feature sections integrate realistic, interactive-looking UI mockups to visually explain complex financial services.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed background image or video that subtly parallaxes or zooms out as the user scrolls, creating an immersive and dynamic introduction, likely orchestrated with GSAP.
Content sections are revealed with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, orchestrated to enhance visual flow and engagement, likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger.
The site employs a sophisticated dark mode theme, using a primary dark background, lighter dark surfaces for cards, and high-contrast light text, accented by a distinct blue for interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, light-weight sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) paired with clear, readable body text
design_tokens.radius: subtle (small border-radius on buttons and card-like elements, typically 4-8px)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced (comfortable spacing between elements and sections, with an airy hero section)

standout: The site's distinctive blend of an aspirational, subtly animated landscape hero with a sophisticated dark mode UI for a financial product creates a unique and memorable brand experience. The integration of realistic, interactive-looking UI mockups within content sections makes complex financial services feel tangible and accessible.
